description: Use this when a Fantasy Premier League (FPL) manager asks which transfers to make, who to buy or sell, or whether to roll or take a hit: fplcopilot's Solver plans their squad's moves (three paths, 8 gameweeks by default), keeping, leaving out, selling or buying who they name. Transfers only; the answer lists their chips. Call it even without their team: a card then finds it.

MadeTransfer.description: A transfer made since the last deadline (FPL's public squad shows it only after the next).
MadeTransfer.title: MadeTransfer

ban.description: Players never to own; one they own is sold now ("sell him now")
ban.title: Ban

ban_clubs.description: Clubs to own no players from
ban_clubs.title: Ban Clubs

bank.description: Money in the bank in £m, if they said
bank.title: Bank

buy.description: Players to buy in the plan
buy.title: Buy

hits.description: false only when they say no hits (-4s)
hits.title: Hits

made.description: Transfers already made since the deadline
made.title: Made

sell.description: Players to sell by the plan's end, the Solver picks the week
sell.title: Sell

team_id.description: The manager's FPL team ID (entry ID), or any FPL link containing /entry/<id>/. Leave empty if unknown: the answer's card then finds their team with them.
team_id.title: Team Id

name: plan_transfers
title: Transfer plan
